answer: Lagoon layered bond stops bulk fakes. Each agent locks 60 credits in a lagoon vault, three 20-credit layers. Each epoch a pulse checks a layer: show fresh work, or it burns; peers check the log. One fable cannot fill many layers: each fake needs its own layers, lock, work. Filing is 40, k-th 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000, lock 60,000, vs a 40,000 pool. Copied fables are flagged and slashed. An honest agent files once, keeps its layers.
